concepts.description: A structural unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated platform component within a module that interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the system communicate and exchange data or events.
A component within a module responsible for managing and directing operations of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within a module to represent fundamental values used throughout the system.
A structured data type defined within a module that aggregates multiple values of potentially different types.
A data field defined within a composite type or interface that holds a specific piece of information.
A signal or occurrence defined within an interface that can be triggered to initiate actions or request information within the system.
A computational unit defined within a module that takes inputs and returns a result, encapsulating specific logic of the system.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module, used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module, used by AUV_Platform to control actuators.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operator commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module, used by controllers to receive input commands and requests.
A controller for the Last Response Engine within AUV_Module, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module, used by controllers to send output commands such as velocity and heading advisories.
A controller within AUV_Module responsible for autopilot functionality, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A value of type real within the SVec composite type, representing the radial component of a spherical vector.
A value of type real within the SVec composite type, representing the polar component of a spherical vector.
A value of type real within the SVec composite type, representing the azimuth component of a spherical vector.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A value of type real within the Obstacle composite type, representing the north-south relative distance to the obstacle.
A value of type real within the Obstacle composite type, representing the east-west relative distance to the obstacle.
A value of type real within the Obstacle composite type, representing the depth of the obstacle.
A value of type real within the Obstacle composite type, representing the identifier of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec within the Obstacle composite type, representing the heading of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface, representing the heading reading from sensors.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface, representing obstacle data from sensors.
An interface defined by AUV_Module containing events for task control and requests for velocity and heading.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, signaling the end of a task.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an obstacle collision mode.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a manual override mode.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a heading correction mode.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters, returning a value of type real representing a requested velocity.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters, returning a value of type real representing a requested heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type recording horiz_cda, vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat, representing close-distance approach data.
A value of type real within the Close composite type, representing the horizontal closest distance of approach.
A value of type real within the Close composite type, representing the vertical closest distance of approach.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
